hook_line: INFOSYS BECOMES WORLD'S FIRST AT CMMI AI MATURITY LEVEL 5

hook_stat.sub: The highest level of the CMMI AI Maturity Model — Infosys is the world's first organization assessed at it

stats.label: Projects in the pool sampled for the assessment across service lines and geographies
Employees worldwide at the Bengaluru-headquartered company

diaspora_bullets: The assessment evaluated how AI is governed, deployed and measured across Infosys's global delivery environment
The assessment sampled real delivery projects rather than a single showcase engagement
news_summary: Infosys has become the world's first organization assessed at Maturity Level 5 of the CMMI AI Maturity (AIM) Model, the model's highest level, in an assessment by Benchmarked Pty Ltd that sampled projects from a pool of more than 1,000.
payoff: For enterprise clients choosing an AI services provider, an independently assessed maturity rating offers a comparison point that marketing claims do not.
